messages.subject: Project Redwood — report on title and tenancies
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Ahead of Thursday's board, please find our report on title and tenancies attached. Headlines:

- Good and marketable freehold title (NGL742118), no issues on the proprietorship register.
- Four tenancies, total passing rent £1,487,500 — full schedule in the report.
- Two points to note: the 2024 Mercer Wells rent review is outstanding (agents quoting £792k vs passing £720k), and Aldgate Print Co has a tenant break in Oct 2027.
- A 1968 restrictive covenant limits building height on the rear yard — not material to the investment but relevant if you ever develop the yard.

Searches are clear. We're comfortable recommending you proceed at £21.75m (6.40% NIY). Happy to take questions.

James

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
DX 134777 Bishopsgate | +44 (0)20 7946 0500
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Redwood — report on title and tenancies
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Yes — clause 13 of the contract will (a) stop the seller agreeing or referring the review after the date of the contract without your consent, and (b) require the seller to account to you for any increased rent referable to the post-completion period. We'll also push for a retention from the price pending the review. I'll cover it at the board if helpful.

James
